purpose: Bind a separate disabled Scheduled Task mailbox result to one exact ACP task/request/execution/logical-attempt and one exact physical mailbox admission.
acceptance: mailbox must have been armed for the exact producer_task_id, mailbox_id, mailbox_generation and admission_nonce
relay must match current ACP task_id/request_digest/request_blob_sha
relay must match current active execution_id/execution_generation
relay logical_attempt must equal the current transport attempt
author_id must equal the expected infrastructure author
terminal must be true and exact UTF-8 payload SHA-256 must match
mailbox known to any lost or suspect producer is quarantined and never reassigned
persistence_order: persist exact raw authored relay bytes to canonical GitHub
re-read and verify raw relay SHA-256 and binding
release gateway only after completed-state re-read
retry_rule: advance logical_attempt and allocate a different physical mailbox; reject any later output from older logical_attempt even if structurally valid
